Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Coordinator/Specialist position for KitchenAid EMEA at Whirlpool Corporation. With a strong background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to bring KitchenAid's Small Domestic Appliances to life online.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my skills in content management and technical SEO. My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to implement structured data and perform technical SEO/GEO audits, directly aligning with your requirements for SEO management and creative asset production.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines content strategy, creative production, and agency collaboration. My experience with video editing and motion graphics, coupled with my organizational skills, makes me well-suited to manage workflows and coordinate with external partners like Flixmedia and RWS.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am eager to contribute to the international KitchenAid team. I look forward to discussing how my skills can support your digital marketing goals.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Coordinator/Specialist position for KitchenAid EMEA at Whirlpool Corporation. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, content creation, and web design, I am drawn to this role because it sits at the intersection of content strategy, creative production, and operational coordination—exactly where my skills and interests lie.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring seamless user experiences. This hands-on experience has given me a solid working knowledge of both on-page and technical SEO, as well as proficiency in tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to execute technical SEO/GEO audits and implement structured data (JSON-LD schema) to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This aligns directly with your need for someone who can manage on-page and technical SEO to ensure content ranks highly and platforms perform seamlessly.

I am also comfortable with video editing and motion graphics, which I have used to create engaging assets for digital platforms. My organizational skills allow me to juggle multiple tasks, track deadlines, and communicate clearly with external agencies—skills essential for coordinating with partners like Flixmedia and RWS.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am eager to bring my enthusiasm for content and digital marketing to the KitchenAid team. I am confident that my proactive, self-directed approach and ability to make informed decisions will make me a valuable asset.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to KitchenAid's digital success.
